{{Quote|There. Roxuli, our last stop in known space.|Captain Pakmillu|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
'''Roxuli''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located at the edge of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], a dispute had arisen between Roxuli's [[Roxuli central government|planetary government]] and the [[Roxuli system/Legends|Roxuli system's]] [[Roxuli asteroids|asteroid]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]], threatening the economic stability of the local [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Roxuli was visited by the Republic [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' as the last stop on its shakedown cruise before it entered [[Star map/Legends|uncharted]] space.

During the starship's stay above the planet, the visiting Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;in reality, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious, who did not wish for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to be [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a planned [[Destruction of Special Task Force One|attack]] on the ''Outbound Flight''&mdash;arranged for the reassignment of Skywalker and his teacher, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], off the ''Outbound Flight'' so that the duo would instead [[Diplomat/Legends|mediate]] negotiations at Roxuli. [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, the planet had become a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
Roxuli was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Roxuli system/Legends|Roxuli system]],<ref name="Outbound" /> a part of the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was linked by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Horob system/Legends|Horob system]] in the adjacent [[Vardoss sector/Legends|Vardoss sector]].<ref name="EGTW" /> From [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Roxuli's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] had a hazy appearance.<ref name="Outbound" />

==History==
===Visit by a starship and a Supreme Chancellor===
{{Quote|May I ask what brings you to this edge of the Republic?"''<br />"[&hellip;]'' Politics, of course. In this case, trouble between the Roxuli central government and the system's asteroid mining colonies.|Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and Supreme Chancellor Palpatine|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
[[File:OutboundFlight-SotGSE.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Outbound Flight'' (pictured) made its last stop in known space at Roxuli.]]
Roxuli lay outside the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], with [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding it becoming well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] between that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which include the dispute in the [[Roxuli system/Legends|Roxuli system]], to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> the [[Roxuli central government|planetary government]] of Roxuli, which was situated at the periphery of the Republic, was involved in an ongoing dispute with the [[Miner/Legends|operators]]<ref name="CSWE Roxuli">{{CSWECite|III|111|Roxuli system}}</ref> of the Roxuli [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Roxuli asteroids|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]],<ref name="Outbound" /> a conflict which eventually required the Republic's intervention.<ref name="CSWE Roxuli" /> That year, Roxuli was scheduled to be the last stop in known space at the conclusion of a three-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long shakedown cruise undertaken by the Republic composite [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', which had the [[Outbound Flight Project|mandate]] of exploring and colonizing the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Outbound" />

After the starship had begun the shakedown cruise, [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] to the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], contacted his secret master, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious&mdash;which, unbeknown to Doriana,<ref name="Outbound" /> was the true identity of Palpatine.<ref name="TEA" /> Doriana relayed to Sidious the fact that [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] student, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], had unexpectedly joined the ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} mission. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] had prepared an [[Destruction of Special Task Force One|attack]] on the vessel in order to both [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] aboard and prevent the ship from encountering the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the "[[Yuuzhan Vong|Far-Outsiders]]," and he did not wish for Skywalker to perish during the event. Thus, Sidious initially ordered Doriana to arrange for the Padawan to leave the ''Outbound Flight'' but shortly thereafter changed his mind, intending to address the matter himself.<ref name="Outbound" />

Less than an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] after the arrival of ''Outbound Flight'' in Roxuli's orbit, Palpatine himself had also arrived there aboard a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. The Supreme Chancellor boarded the starship and used the secure [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] room of the composite vessel's [[Dreadnaught-One|command ship]] for a transmission&mdash;with Doriana speculating during a [[Hologram/Legends|holocommunication]] with Sidious that the Sith Lord was situated at a location closer to the Unknown Regions than [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Outbound" /> the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world,<ref name="TEA" /> was.<ref name="Outbound" />

===Jedi diverted===
{{Quote|But there ''is'' another alternative. Perhaps ''you'' would be willing to mediate in his place.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, to Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, on Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
During Palpatine's presence in the comm room, the ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Pakmillu]], pointed out Roxuli to Kenobi through the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] and noted the historical milestone that the starship's visit to the world represented. Kenobi, who wished to access Roxuli's [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] connection in order to contact the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and request an extension of his mission aboard the ''Outbound Flight'', was then surprised by Palpatine's presence aboard the vessel and at Roxuli.<ref name="Outbound" />

[[File:SkywalkerPalpatine-OutboundFlightJapanese.jpg|thumb|left|300px|At Roxuli, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine (right) arranged for the assignment of Anakin Skywalker (left) off the ''Outbound Flight'' mission.]]
Palpatine subsequently informed Kenobi that the dispute in the Roxuli system threatened the future availability of vital [[Ore/Legends|ore]] shipments to half of the star systems in Roxuli's [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of space. The Supreme Chancellor also claimed that the inhabitants of the Roxuli system had requested that he facilitate for the conflict the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] services of Jedi who had previously been present at highly publicized [[Mission to Barlok|negotiations]] on the planet [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]]&mdash;a group that included [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and leader of the ''Outbound Flight'' [[Jorus C'baoth]], who refused to abandon his mission, and Kenobi. Palpatine then suggested that Kenobi mediate the Roxuli dispute, noting that he had also secured the High Council's support in diverting Kenobi and Skywalker from their original mission.<ref name="Outbound" />

Despite wishing to remain with the ''Outbound Flight'' mission in order to monitor C'baoth's increasingly troubling arrogance and beliefs in Jedi superiority over others, Kenobi accepted Palpatine's request, after which the Supreme Chancellor took the Jedi Knight and his Padawan down to Roxuli aboard his shuttle. During the flight, Skywalker observed the departure of the ''Outbound Flight'' from the system, and the trio briefly discussed C'baoth, with Palpatine subsequently handing Kenobi a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] with compiled information on the Roxuli dispute for him to study during the remainder of the flight.<ref name="Outbound" />

After the shuttle arrived at its destination, Palpatine returned to Coruscant, albeit not without also arranging for Kenobi and Skywalker to be transported back to the Republic's capital once the negotiations had been finished.<ref name="Outbound" /> Roxuli remained outside the Republic's borders during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and had similarly not been incorporated into the territory claimed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it did, however, fall inside the borders of the Empire's successor, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|With your permission, Captain, I'd like to send a signal to Coruscant through Roxuli's HoloNet connection.|Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Captain Pakmillu|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
Roxuli was governed by<ref name="CSWE Roxuli" /> the Roxuli central government. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], Roxuli was connected to the Galactic Republic's HoloNet network.<ref name="Outbound" /> The Roxuli system's population around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roxuli first appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square I-8.<ref name="TEA" />
